title: Emergency clinic (ny Legevakt) at Gjøvik Sykehus: fire concept and deviation chapter, rev. 01
jurisdiction: Norway, Gjøvik kommune as client and owner. Comparative only, not Alberta.

facts.text: Report 'Rapport Brannkonsept for ny Legevakt ved Gjøvik Sykehus'; client Gjøvik kommune; project number 10214684; document RIBr 00, Rev. 01.
Status box marked 'Endelig' (final). Revision history: Rev. 00 on 23.10.2019 (first issue); Rev. 01 on 17.12.2019 (adjustments after independent control).
Stated purpose: help Gjøvik kommune prepare fire-technical design basis in the form of a fire concept and fire drawings for the new emergency clinic.
New work must satisfy TEK17 with VTEK17 guidance (downloaded 01.10.2019).
Project class 3 under SAK10 § 9-4, so independent control applies. Owner is Gjøvik kommune; responsible applicant is JAF arkitektkontor AS.
States that PBL § 31-2 governs formal fire-technical requirements for this type of work.
Basis documents list existing fire drawings as varying ('Eksisterende Branntegninger varierer') and architect plans by JAF arkitekt.
Says it is not practically possible to section off the new emergency clinic on Plan 00 from the rest of the building (translated).
Contains section 4 'Dokumentasjon av fravik' (deviation documentation), pp. 19 to 20; the chapter opens by saying it documents fire-technical performance.

limitations: Comparative test only (Norway, Gjøvik kommune). Local rules are as the report cites them. No Alberta applicability is asserted.
Consultant design-basis report, not a permit decision. The drawings it refers to are not in the PDF (text scan found no plan sheets).
The URL is an innsyn file endpoint; its landing page was not separately verified.
